Name: A Secret Forest Walk
Author: AirynS
Description:
[center][size=6][b]A Secret Forest Walk
[/b]
[/size][size=3]While walking through the secret woods, you stumble across a hidden path... What secrets might it hold? What treasures might lie within? Find out by exploring, but make your choices wisely!

[/size][/center][left][size=3]This mod adds a unique repeatable choose-your-own-adventure event in the secret woods where you can explore, make choices, and decide your path forward. Featuring 14 areas and dozens of interactions for tons of replayability, it's impossible to encounter all of the content in one trip, so you'll need to return each year for another shot at seeing everything the woods have to offer!

To get started, enter the secret woods on a sunny or windy day in fall with at least two clear spaces in your bag. Once you've finished your walk, you'll need to come back in the following year to find it again!

If you find the secret path but aren't quite ready yet, you can [b]head back home[/b] in your first choice; this will allow you to come back the next day instead of missing your chance for the year.[/size][/left]
[size=5][u][b]Configuration[/b][/u]
[/size][size=3]
This mod has two configuration options:
[/size][list]
- [size=3][b]Mystery Mode[/b]: By default when this option is turned off, the narration will give you descriptive hints about what lies on the paths ahead before you make your choice. Turn this option on to remove this hints for an added challenge!
[/size]- [size=3][b]Repeatable Event[/b]: On by default, this option determines whether the event can be repeated each year or whether it will only play once. Turn this option off if you feel like you've seen enough or if you want an added challenge of only being able to make one journey![/size][/list]
[size=5][b][u]Compatibility
[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod should be compatible with all other mods since it uses its own maps rather than using the regular secret woods map. It may however look a little odd with recolour and/or retexture mods, particularly recolours with green fall options, as it uses some custom art assets.

A Secret Forest Walk is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage [/url](it uses the vanilla colouration) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks - Farming[/url]!

[/size][b][u][size=5]Event Guide
[/size][/u][size=3]
[/size][/b][size=3]For a guide to all possible options & interactions, see the following spoiler. Warning: for the best experience, do not click this spoiler until you have played through the event at least once!

[spoiler]

[b]First Room[/b]: Secret Passage

[b]Choices: [/b]None

[b]Paths: [/b]
- West: Junimo Rock
- South-East: Memorial Boulder

[b]Junimo Rock[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:
- Move the rock back (gain a maple seed)
- Leave it where it is (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- South: Woodland Pond
- West: Apple Grove


[b]Memorial Boulder[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Leave 10g (neutral descriptive effect)
- Leave 500g (positive descriptive effect)
- Leave nothing (negative descriptive effect)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- South-West: Dark Path
- South-East: Apple Grove


[b]Woodland Pond[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Swim in the pond (descriptive effect)
- Sit on the bank (descriptive effect)
- Continue walking (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- East: Flower Meadow
- South-East: Apple Grove
- South-West: Dark Path


[b]Apple Grove[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Shake down some fruit (gain 3 apples)
- Eat a fallen apple (eat an apple & heal)
- Wander through the grove (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- East: Flower Meadow
- West: Witch's Tower


[b]Dark Path[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]: None

[b]Paths[/b]:

- South: Wishing Well
- North-West: Witch's Tower


[b]Flower Meadow[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Compliment the fairy (gain 1 fairy stone)
- Insult the fairy (lose 1 apple, gain 1 rotten plant)
- Ignore the fairy (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- South: Pumpkin Patch
- West: Blackberry Bounty


[b]Witch's Tower[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Investigate the tower (descriptive effect)
- Take some amaranth (gain 2 amaranth)
- Leave while you can (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- West: Pumpkin Patch
- South: Blackberry Bounty


[b]Pumpkin Patch[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Check out the giant pumpkin (descriptive effect)
- Investigate the... pumpkin tree? (descriptive effect)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- East: Wishing Well
- North-East: Mushroom Foraging


[b]Wishing Well[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Throw 1g in the well (neutral descriptive effect)
- Throw 100g in the well (gain 1 frozen tea)
- Throw 1000g in the well (gain 1 diamond)
- Throw a rock in the well (negative descriptive effect)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- South-East: Meteorite Crater
- South: Sweet Gem Field


[b]Forest Bounty[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Shake the blackberry bush (gain 3 blackberries)
- Investigate the sapling in the shade (gain 1 pomegranate sapling)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- East: Mushroom Foraging
- South: Meteorite Crater


[b]Mushroom Foraging[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Eat a mushroom (go to sub event)
- Look at the mushroom on the tree stump (gain 1 mushroom tree seed)
- Investigate the mushroom ring (go to sub event)
- Continue on your way (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- East: Sweet Gem Field
- West: Meteorite Crater


[b]Mushroom Foraging[/b]: Eat a mushroom

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Eat a wide flat mushroom (eat and gain 1 chanterelle)
- Eat a small rounded mushroom (eat and gain 1 common mushroom)
- Eat a lopsided holey mushroom (eat and gain 1 morel)
- Eat a short squat mushroom (eat 1 red mushroom)
- Eat a rough speckled mushroom (eat and gain 1 magma cap)
- Eat a bulky oblong mushroom (eat and gain 1 purple mushroom)

[b]Mushroom Foraging[/b]: Investigate the mushroom ring

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Eat a strawberry (go to next day)
- Drink some mead (go to next day)
- Politely decline (gain 1 fairy dust)
- Leave the circle (lose 5000g)


[b]Meteorite Crater[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Investigate the meteorite (go to sub event)
- Look at one of the spheres (gain 1 tiger slime egg)
- Get out of here as fast as possible (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]:

- South: Sweet Gem Field


[b]Meteorite Crater[/b]: Investigate the meteorite

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Carefully pry off some iridium (gain 1 iridium bar)
- Leave it alone (nothing happens)


[b]Sweet Gem Field[/b]

[b]Choices[/b]:

- Pick the berries (gain 2 sweet gem berries)
- Take some seeds instead (gain 1 rare seed)
- Just leave them (nothing happens)

[b]Paths[/b]: None

[/spoiler][/size]
